Sentence (English): So far I do like the LG 'stainless steel like' dishwasher.
Comments (English): So far I do like the LG 'stainless steel like' dishwasher. I have had for about a month now. I wanted something with simpler features- not a 'smart' dishwasher. The stainless steel interior is nice and the size inside is good. It is pretty quiet, as well. I like the fact that it has a leak proof feature. The stainless steel 'like' on the front of dishwasher looks like real stainless steel to me and you can also apply something magnetic to the front of it. The only negative - which actually is not too bad - is the printed lettering of the control settings on the front at the top of dishwasher- they are kind of hard to read due to the dark lettering against the stainless steel but I really don't change my settings much anyway. I pretty much just leave them on the normal tyoe settings - hit the power and then START. My dishes come out very clean. Overall, I like the dishwasher and have no complaints.

Comments (English): [ Delighted with my Bosch dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I really like the dishwasher, I have had it for about 10 days and so far it works correctly, makes little noise and is very spacious. I like the cutlery tray, it takes a while to place them, but the convenient thing is that it is very easy to store afterwards, I also really like that you can adjust the height of the upper basket. To say something negative, it is that the door does not stay open a little to ventilate once the program has finished, some other brands do, in this one you have to open it almost halfway, otherwise it automatically closes again and Another is that the trays get a little stuck when entering or removing them, especially the cutlery tray. Sentence (English): I'm getting to love this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Cleans wonderfully ] || ---------------- || I'm getting to love this dishwasher. It took some getting used to because the racks are totally different from my old Whirlpool. Items don't fit where they used to in my old machine, and now I have a 3rd rack on the top. Also, not a fan of the silverware compartment which is much smaller than my old one and harder to get the wider silverware handles out of the compartments when putting away clean dishes. Those are all of the cons. Now for the pros: It fits more dishes than my old machine. The plate tines are so close together you wonder how in the world those plates will get clean--but they do! Getting to love the 3rd rack even tho it is so short that a 1-cup measuring cup won't fit. There are so many items that do fit up there and that frees up space on the other racks for additional items. LOVE the app where you can customize a cycle just for what you have loaded, adjust the amount of rinse agent, start the dishwasher remotely and be notified when the cycle is complete. Most of all it does a spectacular job cleaning the dishes! It's so nice not to have to inspect every dish before I put it away. Definately recommend this dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ installation nightmare ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher in January. We were told it would be delivered and in a couple of days, a plumber would come and install. To our surprise, the delivery guys installed the dishwasher. 3 months later, the dishwasher started to tip forward as i was loading. It was not attached to the cabinets. Just pushed in. After serveral calls, Home Depot agreed to send someone out to install it again. Those guys worked an hour to install the dishwasher, however it was installed crooked. We decided to live with it. 3 months later, the dishwasher was even more crooked and leaning. We called an appliance guy to reinstall it. The dishwasher was screwed into our cabinets with the wrong kind of screws making it nearly impossible to get the dishwasher out. After much determination, the dishwasher comes out only to find out that the reason the dishwasher was leaning was because the casing for the adjustable leg was stripped and the leg won't hold its position. Sentence (English): I really like the dishwasher, I have had it for about 10 days and so far it works correctly, makes little noise and is very spacious.
Comments (English): [ I love my new Bosch dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I really like the dishwasher, I have had it for about 10 days and so far it works correctly, makes little noise and is very spacious. I like the cutlery tray, it takes a while to place them, but the convenient thing is that it is very easy to store later. I also really like that you can adjust the height of the upper basket. To say something negative, it is that the door does not stay open a little to ventilate once the program has finished, some of other brands do, in this one you have to open it almost halfway, otherwise it automatically closes again and Another is that the trays get a little stuck when entering or removing them, especially the cutlery tray. I don't know if it will soften with use, but it doesn't interfere with the operation at all, you just get the hang of it. In general I am delighted, it is very pretty and the best thing it also has is the Home Connect application, it is very intuitive to use.
Comments (Original): [ Me encanta mi nuevo lavavajillas Bosch ] || ---------------- || Me gusta mucho el lavavajillas, lo tengo desde hace unos 10 días y hasta ahora funciona correctamente, hace poco ruido y es muy espacioso. Me gusta la bandeja de los cubiertos, tardas un poco al colocarlos, pero lo cómodo es que luego es muy fácil de guardar. también me gusta mucho que se pueda regular la altura de la cesta superior. Por decir algo en negativo, es que la puerta no se queda un poco abierta para ventilar una vez finalizado el programa, algunos de otras marcas sí que lo hace, en este has de abrirla hasta casi la mitad, sino automáticamente vuelve a cerrarse y lo otro es que las bandejas se traban un poco entrarlas o sacarlas, sobre todo la de los cubiertos, no sé si se irá suavizando con el uso, pero no interfiere nada al funcionamiento solo es pillarle el truco. En general estoy encantada, es muy bonito y lo mejor que tiene también es la aplicación Home Connect, es muy intuitiva de utilizar.

Sentence (English): I really like the dishwasher, I have had it for about 10 days and so far it works correctly, makes little noise and is very spacious.
Comments (English): [ Delighted with my Bosch dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I really like the dishwasher, I have had it for about 10 days and so far it works correctly, makes little noise and is very spacious. I like the cutlery tray, it takes a while to place them, but the convenient thing is that it is very easy to store afterwards, I also really like that you can adjust the height of the upper basket. To say something negative, it is that the door does not stay open a little to ventilate once the program has finished, some other brands do, in this one you have to open it almost halfway, otherwise it automatically closes again and Another is that the trays get a little stuck when entering or removing them, especially the cutlery tray. I don't know if it will soften with use, but it doesn't interfere with the operation at all, you just get the hang of it. Por decir algo en negativo, es que la puerta no se queda un poco abierta para ventilar una vez finalizado el programa, algunos de otras marcas sí que lo hace, en este has de abrirla hasta casi la mitad, sino automáticamente vuelve a cerrarse y lo otro es que las bandejas se traban un poco entrarlas o sacarlas, sobre todo la de los cubiertos, no sé si se irá suavizando con el uso, pero no interfiere nada al funcionamiento solo es pillarle el truco. En general estoy encantada, es muy bonito y lo mejor que tiene también es la aplicación Home Connect, es muy intuitiva de utilizar.

To say something negative, it is that the door does not stay open a little to ventilate once the program has finished, some other brands do, in this one you have to open it almost halfway, otherwise it automatically closes again and Another is that the trays get a little stuck when entering or removing them, especially the cutlery tray. I don't know if it will soften with use, but it doesn't interfere with the operation at all, you just get the hang of it. In general I am delighted, it is very nice and the best thing it also has is the Home Connect application, it is very intuitive to use.
Comments (Original): [ Encantada con mi lavavajillas Bosch ] || ---------------- || Me gusta mucho el lavavajillas, lo tengo desde hace unos 10 días y hasta ahora funciona correctamente, hace poco ruido y es muy espacioso. Me gusta la bandeja de los cubiertos, tardas un poco al colocarlos, pero lo cómodo es que luego es muy fácil de guardar, también me gusta mucho que se pueda regular la altura de la cesta superior. Por decir algo en negativo, es que la puerta no se queda un poco abierta para ventilar una vez finalizado el programa, algunos de otras marcas sí que lo hace, en este has de abrirla hasta casi la mitad, sino automáticamente vuelve a cerrarse y lo otro es que las bandejas se traban un poco entrarlas o sacarlas, sobre todo la de los cubiertos, no sé si se irá suavizando con el uso, pero no interfiere nada al funcionamiento solo es pillarle el truco. En general estoy encantada, es muy bonito y lo mejor que tiene también es la aplicación Home Connect, es muy intuitiva de utilizar.

Comments (English): [ Life appliances ] || ---------------- || # Date of purchase: October 27, 2023 # Color: Kota White, 14 people # Family members: 2 adults, 1 child, 1 newborn # Price: It varies, but I bought it for under 100 including the card discount. When Samsung Festa was held, the 2023 model (hot air drying) was 149 on the SAMSUNG site, but if Solkka is 50, there is a big difference, and I heard that the hot air drying effect is not dramatic yet. Things to note when ordering: I moved on November 9th, and the desired installation date was the 9th. The person who came on the 9th was the person who did the actual measurement. Since it was a full remodeling, the actual measurement was not necessary and the installation could be done right away, but the person who did the actual measurement said, 'Installation will start a day after the actual measurement. It cannot be done on the same day.' Ha. So in the end, the installation was received on November 10th, a day after the desired date. (Coupang CS confidently said it would be installed on the 9th. It seems like they haven't received enough training yet.) # Noise: Think of it as a hybrid EV mode for a car. It's quieter than the sound of running water in a sink. FYI. I really hate loud noises. # Satisfaction: # People around me say that the dishwasher doesn't clean properly and that things don't stick. As you can see in my pictures, the coffee stains from the morning, the grease and red pepper powder from eating pork, which is the human food of Korean men, and the rice cakes from the rice bowl that I left to eat when I'm hungry in the evening, they've all been eliminated. The top, middle, and bottom blades rotate in a triple layer and spray water. How could there be any residue left? I took the same dishes in the before and after pictures for verification. # Overall: This is one of the home appliances my wife bought when she moved this time, and this is really satisfying. If I had to buy it again, I would definitely buy it next time. This is why I trust Jaeyong hyung.

Sentence (English): I wish I could select 4.9 stars.
Comments (English): [ Love it! ] || ---------------- || I wish I could select 4.9 stars.I bought this dishwasher about 5 months ago from a local home appliance store and absolutely love how quiet it is. There are times that I don't realize it's running while I'm watching TV in the same great room (kitchen, dining room and living room). The 3rd rack at the top is awesome for small items such as spatulas and whisks. I've never been disappointed at how clean the dishes come out - even dried on eggs after sitting for 2 days. I've only used the Normal cycle and never use the heated dry feature, but do shake the water off of the plastic tubs and turn them sideways to dry. It did take a bit of getting used to the layout of the racks and learning how to efficiently put the dishes in the rack so they are facing the center. I've discovered that salad plates will fit in the main top rack which frees up space on the bottom rack for larger items such as dinner plates and mixing bowls.The wash cycle takes a bit longer than my previous dishwasher and I wish it had a countdown timer so I know how much longer before it's complete. This is the only thing keeping me from giving a 5 star rating.

Sentence (English): Due to our old kitchen cabinets, we had to purchase an ADA Compliant dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Very Basic Dishwasher-No Frills ] || ---------------- || Due to our old kitchen cabinets, we had to purchase an ADA Compliant dishwasher. There aren't very many out there, very limited. We decided on this GE as it was the only one we could get before January. Pros: 1) It cleans well. Cons: 1) Does not have a heating element to dry. We set the timer for the end of the cycle, 48 minutes for light wash and then open the door slightly and hang a dish towel over the door to absorb the water. If we don't do this, anything plastic is dripping wet. 2) Does not have a rinse cycle. Again, we set the timer for 8 minutes and then turn the machine off-it drains the water out and they are rinsed. 3) Does not have a third rack. 4) Does not have fingerprint resistant stainless steel on the panel. Therefore, fingerprints every time it is used. 5) Old machine used to have a front panel display, this is top panel. Hard to see when done unless a timer is set. But it does clean well. We went without a dishwasher for 3 months, so I guess anything is better than nothing!

Comments (English): [ Design Defects ] || ---------------- || Dishwasher arrived in good condition. It was generally as advertised, however there are several design defects that buyers should be aware of. These were identified during installation.1 - Trim isn't able to grab onto the front dishwasher flange due to thinness of flange. During installation, it was necessary to fabricate several additional shims to increase the thickness of the front flange so that the trim can latch. Without the additional shims, the side trim does not latch on the top or bottom of the front flange, creating a loose trim.2 - The connection for the hot water hose into the dishwasher rotates easily. If it rotates, then water will spill out along the outside side of the dishwasher. This needs to be secured. Steam also vents out this port on the outside side of teh dishwasher and it is open on the top. This steam could (in theory) cause cabinet damage (left side of dishwasher). (not in instructions).3-Additionally, the hose connecting into the hot water hose connection on the side of the dishwasher does not come with a hose clamp, so you will need to provide and install your own. (not in instructions)4-hot water hose connection is plastic (not uncommon), rather than brass and is easily stripped out. Installer should take great care while installing.5. For proper drying of dishes, the "heated" boost feature is needed.6. Dishwasher cycles are 1.5-2 hours.7. There is not a good place to place bowls in the racks.Dishwasher generally appears to clean properly.

Sentence (English): I purchased this to replace an older, similar model, Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 100 Premium Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I purchased this to replace an older, similar model, Bosch dishwasher. The previous model had a couple pump failures and was becoming a reliability issue.Installation - The Bosch 100 Premium was an easy install as a replacement. Unfortunately, I needed to purchase a hardWIRE kit, and a 90 degree water inlet elbow. I'm not sure why the latter wasn't included in the dishwasher design. I can't imagine where a front facing water inlet would make sense in any application.Appearance - I appreciate the clean facia, hidden buttons, and rigid door handle. These are all improvements over the previous design. Function - So far, so good. The dishwasher does what its supposed to do, and it cleans well. It has an option for a quick cycle which works pretty well if you are like us and tend to pre-rinse dishes. I also appreciate the Home Connect App though the reality is that I will seldom use the control options available. It does however contain helpful information. The unit is comparable in sound level to my previous Bosch unit, as quietness is one of the reasons that I appreciate the Bosch brand.Overall, I am impressed with the Bosch 100 Premium. I hope that it lasts longer than my previous unit which made it about 11 years. Time will tell.

Sentence (English): Ah.
Comments (English): Ah. Countertop vs. Built-in. I agonized over this for months. ^^; I read product reviews over and over again. Actually, it’s not that expensive compared to other appliances. But for some reason, I just hesitated about dishwashers. I worried I might be buying it just for my own convenience. So, I agonized over it until the very end. The price difference between the built-in and countertop models wasn't *that* huge. In fact, older built-in models were in the 400,000 won range. Since there was a possibility that the built-in might not install, I finally decided on the countertop! The price was also super good. It was in the 400,000 won range, but with a card discount, I bought it in the late 300,000 won range. ^^. It's a consumable item anyway. I even thought, "If it works well this time, maybe I'll get a 12-place setting built-in next time?" Ah. It’s so, so good! Clean! Squeaky clean! Hot and fresh! I don't know why I hesitated at all. My house generates quite a lot of dishes, so I was considering a 12-place setting built-in. The 6-person capacity is sufficient. It's also great for running without worry when there isn't much to wash. First off, I have more time with the kids now. I do the dishes, go for a walk, and it's done! Dinner time has become so much more relaxed. (I really love this part.) Since it was Rocket Delivery, it was installed the very next day after purchase. Ah, I suppose that would have been unimaginable if I had bought it elsewhere, right? After installation, I thought they would at least give me a detergent sample. But there wasn't one. Thanks to a friend, I used it right after installation and then purchased it via Rocket Delivery. If you are ordering, I recommend ordering detergent along with it. The installers were kind, but I wish they had explained things a little more. They said there was nothing to explain and just told me to press the power button, select a course, and that was it. But it turns out there is a filter cleaner. For people like me who find reading manuals incredibly bothersome, hearing the explanation is much better. That was a bit disappointing. Oh! Noise is important, right? It doesn't happen constantly, but occasionally it makes a sound similar to a washing machine. The door opens automatically when the washing is finished, but you shouldn't just open it immediately. There is moisture from the humidity. Please note that if you take items out 1-2 hours after the automatic door opens, they will be dry and fluffy. Many people seem very satisfied with the dryer, but after trying various things, I am actually much more satisfied with the dishwasher and the robot mop cleaner than the dryer. Ah, this product's price fluctuates a lot. It appeared in the Gold Box a few days ago, so I saw it available for purchase in the low 300,000 won range. If you like it but are hesitating and aren't in a hurry, add it to your cart and choose it at a good price!

Sentence (English): Countertop vs. Built-in.
Comments (English): Ah. Countertop vs. Built-in. I agonized over this for months. ^^; I read product reviews over and over again. Actually, it’s not that expensive compared to other appliances. But for some reason, I just hesitated about dishwashers. I worried I might be buying it just for my own convenience. So, I agonized over it until the very end. The price difference between the built-in and countertop models wasn't *that* huge. In fact, older built-in models were in the 400,000 won range. Since there was a possibility that the built-in might not install, I finally decided on the countertop! The price was also super good. It was in the 400,000 won range, but with a card discount, I bought it in the late 300,000 won range. ^^. It's a consumable item anyway. I even thought, "If it works well this time, maybe I'll get a 12-place setting built-in next time?" Ah. It’s so, so good! Clean! Squeaky clean! Hot and fresh! I don't know why I hesitated at all. My house generates quite a lot of dishes, so I was considering a 12-place setting built-in. The 6-person capacity is sufficient. It's also great for running without worry when there isn't much to wash. First off, I have more time with the kids now. I do the dishes, go for a walk, and it's done! Dinner time has become so much more relaxed. (I really love this part.) Since it was Rocket Delivery, it was installed the very next day after purchase. Ah, I suppose that would have been unimaginable if I had bought it elsewhere, right? After installation, I thought they would at least give me a detergent sample. But there wasn't one. Thanks to a friend, I used it right after installation and then purchased it via Rocket Delivery. If you are ordering, I recommend ordering detergent along with it. The installers were kind, but I wish they had explained things a little more. They said there was nothing to explain and just told me to press the power button, select a course, and that was it. But it turns out there is a filter cleaner. For people like me who find reading manuals incredibly bothersome, hearing the explanation is much better. That was a bit disappointing. Oh! Noise is important, right? It doesn't happen constantly, but occasionally it makes a sound similar to a washing machine. The door opens automatically when the washing is finished, but you shouldn't just open it immediately. There is moisture from the humidity. Please note that if you take items out 1-2 hours after the automatic door opens, they will be dry and fluffy. Sentence (English): I purchased this to replace an older, similar model, Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 100 Premium Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I purchased this to replace an older, similar model, Bosch dishwasher. The previous model had a couple pump failures and was becoming a reliability issue. Installation - The Bosch 100 Premium was an easy install as a replacement. Unfortunately, I needed to purchase a hardWIRE kit, and a 90 degree water inlet elbow. I'm not sure why the latter wasn't included in the dishwasher design. I can't imagine where a front facing water inlet would make sense in any application. Appearance - I appreciate the clean facia, hidden buttons, and rigid door handle. These are all improvements over the previous design. Function - So far, so good. The dishwasher does what its supposed to do, and it cleans well. It has an option for a quick cycle which works pretty well if you are like us and tend to pre-rinse dishes. I also appreciate the Home Connect App though the reality is that I will seldom use the control options available. It does however contain helpful information. The unit is comparable in sound level to my previous Bosch unit, as quietness is one of the reasons that I appreciate the Bosch brand. Overall, I am impressed with the Bosch 100 Premium. I hope that it lasts longer than my previous unit which made it about 11 years. Time will tell.

There is NO heating element on the floor of this dishwasher, thus (I believe) completely eliminating any possibility of melting plastic items. You will love this product! Especially this series and above. More expensive? Yes. However, as the owner of three other previous dishwasher brands and as life often teaches us - you get what you pay-for. ENJOY a wise purchase.

Sentence (English): I was originally told that the unit would be dropped off and within 24 hours the installers would be scheduled.
Comments (English): [ Installation ] || ---------------- || I was originally told that the unit would be dropped off and within 24 hours the installers would be scheduled. I was a little surprised and had to adjust my schedule when I found out the delivery team was going to install as well. They were professional and prompt calling when they were on their way. They did an amazing job leveling the unit and installing it. I was a little surprised that the water valve had to be replaced but once he turned it on it did start to drip. They were there with the unit and said they could replace it for $200 which, for a little valve I thought was a lot (seems that it isn't when I benchmarked) and they said I could do it myself or have another plumber do it and they would come back but we wanted it in so originally it seemed like a scam but the cost, when benchmarked, was reasonable. The unit itself is so very quiet it is hard to know if it is running. It does an amazing job cleaning the dishes. Only two things make it less than perfect. There was a description of a silver wear insert for the third (top) drawer which did not come with it and I'm trying to find one now to put in and the left front wheels (as you're looking at the unit) come off now and then. The last note is that the buttons are sensitive so if you touch them when you are opening it to put dishes in or closing it afterwards you have to watch not to touch any of them and only use the handle to open and close. Otherwise I would say great value for the money. Our old unit was 20 years old so I hope this one lasts as long as well although I did repair that old one about 6 times for various things over the years.

Sentence (English): We have used this dishwasher for a little over a year, and I can't find anything I like about it.
Comments (English): [ Finicky and poor-performing dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We have used this dishwasher for a little over a year, and I can't find anything I like about it. We have to pre-wash everything impeccably, otherwise the dishwasher acts as a food processor and leaves little crumbs over all dishes, and we have to re-wash things. The front quarter of the top rack is unusable because if you put anything near the front edge, the soap dispenser won't open, and we have to re-wash things. The bottom level also only effectively cleans flat items, and all bowls must go on top. I've never had such a finicky dishwasher. To get any functionality out of this machine, we can only run really small pre-cleaned and perfectly arranged loads. Any "efficiency" it might have is lost to having to run many small loads to deal with it's needs.I also really miss having an option to air dry my dishes that my last dishwasher had.

Sentence (English): Quite disappointed as I thought a Bosch would be a great machine.
Comments (English): [ some major defects in design ] || ---------------- || Quite disappointed as I thought a Bosch would be a great machine. It cleans well but the design is poor. The bottom rack is hard to load. The folding tines are worthless because they are just tines that line up with non folding tines, so folding them does nothing. The 3rd rack is too shallow to fit anything other than utensils. The wine glass stem holder is very shallow and does not hold a standard size stem. Only an extremely thin stem would fit, and I wouldn't trust it with thin stems. Also, thin stem glasses are taller and probably wouldn't even fit. The silverware rack does not hold silverware for 16 servings. 5 servings maybe. There is no remote start (that is VERY disappointing). I can start it with my phone, but if it want it to run it during the night I have to remember to get up and start it from my phone remotely. That is of no benefit, I could just as easily set an alarm for midnight and then go downstairs and manually start it. If you add something to it once it has started you have to push the resume button. In 68 years I have never had a dishwasher that you can't add to while running without hitting a button. Of course, everyone forgets and then the dishwasher doesn't finish running. Also you have to hit a button to turn on, a button (or buttons) to select programs and then the start button. Again, no other dishwasher does that. Normally you would hit the program and then a start button, but having to also hit on/off is just an extra thing to remember to do. If i had it to do over I would buy a KitchenAid.

Sentence (English): After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband.
Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Sentence (English): Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Sentence (English): It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean.
Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Sentence (English): It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean.
Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Sentence (English): It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time.
Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up.
