It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Sentence (English): Things to do before installing the dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

Comments (English): [ After much deliberation, the dishwasher lady came to our house too~ ] || ---------------- || After much deliberation, we finally got a dishwasher for my husband. ^^. Since we both work, my husband ends up doing the dishes a lot. We're always busy in the mornings, so we'd often just leave the dishes in the sink without time to clean them up. My husband often gets home first from work, so it's his turn to do the dishes. Maybe that's why he keeps calling out for a dishwasher. I'd rather just wash them by hand. It's a waste of money, energy, and the dishes don't get washed clean. My sister, who used one a long time ago, said it wasn't very good, so I never thought about getting one. Even before I installed it, I was so annoyed by the exhaustion of organizing the lower cabinets! But now, after two weeks of using it, I've found myself loving the dishwasher's skill. It's so clean, sterilizes, and rinses safely, and it even saves me time. I wonder why I ever thought about it. I chose the solid green because I wanted to give it a pop of color since it's a white lower cabinet. It's a 12-person unit, but I thought it looked similar to a 14-person unit, so I bought it. I chose the DUBJ4GL model, which features 100-degree steam, high-temperature sterilization, and hot air drying. When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. The automatic door opening function after washing quickly releases heat, so the dish is squeaky clean and well-dried. Water sometimes collects on the lids of side dishes or the bottom of rice bowls, but if you play Tetris well, it dries well. Playing Tetris at an angle is the key. I still lack the skills! I'm giving the Tetris to my husband. The discount rate for the mysteriously colored solid green dishwasher changes from time to time. I hope you check for a good price and get a great deal. It's divided into three tiers. Flat items like spoons, ladles, and spatulas are placed on the top tier. Bowls, soup bowls, and plates are placed on the second tier. Large items like pots, large plates, and frying pans are neatly stacked on the bottom tier. To wash them thoroughly, cut a half tablet into the second tier and put it in a dishwasher-safe container. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. When installing the dishwasher, they didn't provide dishwasher-specific detergent, so I hurriedly searched and ordered the highly-reviewed Prosh Rinse All-in-One Tablet, which I'm using. I use one tablet for 12 people, but when the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, half a tablet cleans them thoroughly. Things to do before installing the dishwasher. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Coordinate the installation date and time carefully (it may take 2-3 hours to prepare the lower cabinet, and 1-2 hours for installation). Prepare the lower cabinet in advance before installing the dishwasher. Buy dishwasher detergent in advance (I thought they would give you a detergent sample, so I didn't buy it, but I ordered it last minute^^,). I need 1kg of dishwasher salt (water softener function prevents water stains). Bringing things into the house is a lot of thinking! ^^ I hope you carefully consider everything and make a wise purchase~. They say worrying only makes you older, so I worried and ended up wasting a lot of time and effort, and I feel like I wasted my precious time on washing dishes^^. I hope you can quickly be free from dishwashing and have some free time~

When the amount of dishes is small and there's no grease, the standard function takes 55 minutes. If you add steam and hot air drying to the basic function, it runs for about 1 hour and 20 minutes. You must have a hard time choosing a detergent. Decide on the installation location and measure the size of the dishwasher. Comments (English): [ Cleans great, but Costco logistics bad. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher cleans better than any dishwasher I have ever owned, but it does get a lot of error messages. I have to go outside and turn the circuit breakers on and off. I still like it. Costco installing was bad. Very bad. You would think one appointment would do it, right? Well, no. First, the four hour window to get it delivered. Well, you don't find out until the day before what the time is, so you have to take the whole day off. And that is just to get it dropped off. Then installation - another day off. Except they cancelled the day of. And then another appointment a week or so later. Then they came and since the dishwasher was not RIGHT NEXT to the sink, they could not install it. This was about a month after I ordered it at this point. So I had to get a handyman to install it - which was actually a super easy install because the hoses went right under the house and I have a big crawl space. My handyman did it in just a few minutes, but the guys Costco sent were not authorized to do anything but install a dishwasher right next to a sink. NO one bothered to look. So - they did give me a discount on the install, but what a giant pain. Also, I don't know why I keep getting an E1 error message, but I just start it over again. It does clean really well. I do live in a somewhat rural area, but that should not be an excuse for the terrible installation and delivery issues.

Sentence (English): We decided to splurge and purchased a Bosch 800 Series SHP878ZD2N dishwasher not too long ago.
Comments (English): [ Parts are difficult to replace ] || ---------------- || We decided to splurge and purchased a Bosch 800 Series SHP878ZD2N dishwasher not too long ago. We'd read all of the reviews touting the superior industry ratings and felt assured that the money would be well invested in a product that would reliably work for at least a decade - possibly more. Initially, we were very pleased with the purchase. The washer operated as promoted. It was very quiet. We had no issues with consistent and thorough cleaning. No problems. until we had one. We began receiving an "E15 Watertap" error code. We called an appliance repair specialist. He examined the washer and confirmed that the code identified a leak caused by a faulty part (Part#: BOS ********). And here's where the problem got worse - the appliance repair group would not support replacing the part. According to the appliance repair group, the specific replacement part has a known poor reliability record. Since they (the appliance repair business) do not have confidence in the repair, they will not perform the repair. My wife and I were very surprised. We thought this position not to perform the repair may be unique to the particular repair business. So, we contacted a second repair business to ask if they would perform the repair. We were stunned to discover that they shared the same perspective as the first repair business and would not replace the part. Thus, we are left with a very expensive (and not old) dishwasher that appliance repair groups will not make operational. We are apparently back in the market for a new dishwasher. And we are reading all the same reviews touting the reliability and quality of Bosch. But this time we will be a lot more cautious when considering the credibility of those claims.

Sentence (English): This isn't so much a review on the product but on Lowe's.
Comments (English): [ Total disaster ] || ---------------- || This isn't so much a review on the product but on Lowe's. Our saga to replace our broken dishwasher has been going on for almost 2 months due to Lowe's not following up and make sure things on the order updated appropriately. For one this is the second dishwasher that was delivered to Lowe's. The first one was damaged during shipping. Here is where things get bad. A Lowe's rep called me and said they would process the return and order a new replacement amd they would let us know when it came in and was ready for scheduling. So far I was upset but at least we would get the dishwasher right? Wrong 2 weeks or so go by and nothing. I call Lowe's spend 40 or so minutes arguing with their terrible answering machine thing, which I have spent more time arguing with than should be humanely allowed, and find finally find out no order ws placed, but the dishwasher that was delivered was on the floor already so it could be sold. Finally replacement ordered. So far so good, right. No, dishwasher gets to store and installed. Now for most errors on the dishwasher there is a list of steps to take to troubleshoot from home, but there is on error that all is says is turn off power turn off water and call installer and/or manufacturer. LC or leak check, apparently there are two ways for this error to show incorrect install and actual leak. Here is another time when Lowe's dropped the ball as well as Samsung and the installer. Samsung was just super in flexible and never showed up when we scheduled them. We also never knew when we would get seen so I had to reschedule meetings just to waste my waiting for nothing. Lowe's had to be constantly called to make sure that the my tickets, yes more than one were being processed and pushed through. The installer came out twice the first one only leveled the machine and didn't check for leaks. We had to call again and have them come out and they found and actual leak. Now here we go for the next part. Now we know we have a broken dishwasher, technically the second. We go to the store down the street and spend 2 hours looking for a dishwasher that is on stock so we can get it installed quickly, we are 6 weeks into this fiasco. We decide on one in-stock and compete the return. I asked the lady when should we expect a call from the installer, I was told by Wed at the latest. Sounds good, satisfied I didn't explode at the innocent employees for all the trouble so far. Time progresses and we'd comes and goes. I call Lowe's and again do the job that was supposed to be done of Sat when we went to the store. The order was never updated again to ready for delivery. So the installer was never contacted again. Get that sorted out, by the way 20 minutes wasted arguing with answering machine. So far so good, not. The install team checks with the store and confirmed that as of that day our dishwasher was at the store and labeled for us. Paperwork updated I call installer again and get told they can't expedite anything without ticket from Lowe's and that takes 2 days to process, earliest I would get call is Monday. Ok fine, wait till Monday and we do in fact get a call and get scheduled for install on black Friday. Now Thanksgiving comes and goes the battle against dishes happens and hopes of Fri install of new dishwasher would bring relief right? Wrong yet again. Lowe's screwed up again. At some point from the time we checked on our dishwasher on the Thursday prior till Friday they sold our dishwasher and our installer shows up to pickup nothing so he can install nothing, so no dishwasher. I'm never working with Lowe's again, this is completely unacceptable two have so many screw-ups and still feel like there is air of nonchalance. We are supposed to wait till Monday again to get an update. How can a simple project order dishwasher and have installed get so screwed. Easily no one is doing their job of following up and make sure things get done right. When the customer has to make sure the order is being updated appropriately and doing the job of the last employee they dealt with just to get the order taken care of there is an issue. Yes I understand that they are understaffed but a certain level of care is all I ask. I'm not getting paid to argue with that monstrosity of a machine and then make sure that my order is going to get to me.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher I used at home was Midea five years ago, so the machine should be fine this time around, but the installation process is hard to describe.
Comments (English): The dishwasher I used at home was Midea five years ago, so the machine should be fine this time around, but the installation process is hard to describe. First of all, I received calls from at least two installers who wanted to install them at my door. After asking, they said they were from the same outlet and the management was too confusing. They also asked me on the phone why I bought 10 sets of dishwashers. Is it for factory use or for home use? Usually there are 1 set and 2 sets, which shows that you are not familiar with the product. Secondly, the water inlet and drain pipes that come with the machine are not long enough. The installer only extended the water inlet pipe but not the drain pipe. There was a drain pipe left outside that was not connected, and he asked me to confirm acceptance. In the end, I didn’t know what to change in the so-called free cabinet modification. It would cost extra to open two holes, and the sealing plate in the upper gap could not be solved. In the end, I asked my whole-house customization master for help. It is recommended that you prepare extension pipes in advance. It is not cheap to use the ones provided by the installer.
Comments (Original): 家里五年前洗碗机用的就是美的，这次机器应该也不会差，只是安装过程一言难尽。首先，接到至少两个安装师傅的电话要给我上门安装，询问后说是同一个网点，管理太混乱，电话里还问我为什么买个10套洗碗机，是工厂用的吗，家用一般都是1套2套，可见对产品不熟悉。其次，机器自带的进水管排水管都不够长，安装师傅只有进水管延长、没有排水管延长，留了根排水管在外面没有接，还要让我确认验收。最后所谓的免费橱改也不知道改点啥，开两个孔要额外收费，上方空隙的封板也解决不了，最后还是找我全屋定制师傅帮的忙。建议大家还是提前备好延长管，用安装师傅的实在是不便宜。

Sentence (English): I purchased this GE Profile dishwasher 18 months ago.
Comments (English): [ GE Profile Dishwasher motor failure; careful! ] || ---------------- || I purchased this GE Profile dishwasher 18 months ago. It worked great for the first year. Then we noticed a substantial decline in performance. Dishes were often dirty, especially dishes on the top rack. We then noticed a big drop in water temperature and loss of pressure that caused the upper spray arm to stop working. It wouldn't dissolve a dishwasher soap puck.We had a technician in to troubleshoot as we were 6 months outside of our warrantee. The technician (not from GE) told us that GE Profile dishwashers are dropping like flies due to a faulty motor and poor workmanship. He pointed out that our trim on the outside of the dishwasher was peeling due to the heat.He said they look nice but many experts have become VERY unhappy with the GE Profile. He diagnosed the problem as a failing motor and quoted me ~$600 to fix it. He said I would be better off going to buy a Maytag or a Bosch.I called GE today and was more or less told that there were no options. I have been a long time GE customer but now it's the end of the road. That's the second dishwasher that failed on us in less than 3 years. The last one had a failed control panel. I'm not sure if all the great reviews on this shown here are from people who had the dishwasher for less than 12 months but it seems I'm not alone. This was a bad purchase and I would strongly encourage you to do more research and find another brand. GE isn't cutting it with quality and value.

I had a third-party 6-seater dishwasher. I had been using it, but since I recently moved, I wanted to keep using it, but it opens on both sides, so I couldn't use it on the sink in my current house. (It just added to the burden of moving.) So I decided to get a 12-seater, but since I had just bought a new refrigerator and other appliances and furniture, I was worried about the cost of buying more appliances. Also, since my kitchen is not that big, I would have to move back and forth to use a standing dishwasher, and if I wanted a built-in dishwasher, it wouldn't be my house (the sadness of renting). It wouldn't be easy to install. So I gave up on the dishwasher and decided to hand-wash the dishes. I have two kids, and my husband, who is a big eater, doesn't like home cooking *.* Spoons and forks overflowing in the straw cup, various cooking utensils even though I only had one meal. Etc. I was worried that my blood pressure would go up while washing dishes, so I looked into it and looked into it again~~ After searching through all the Mom Cafes, I ordered this Bespoke dishwasher! It’s okay even if you have a small kitchen! Since the door opens forward, in this direction! It’s okay even if the space between the upper and lower cabinets of the sink is narrow! Since the door doesn’t open up and down, there’s no unnecessary clutter, and I was surprised by how quiet it was. And, it has a strong mode, a full wash mode, and a sterilization mode, so I’m so satisfied! I’m a professional cleaner + sensitive to grease, but I’m really satisfied with it. It has two built-in spoon holders, and there’s a separate space on the top to put things like children’s cups, so it’s really convenient! In particular, there’s a stand for placing plates or bowls, so you can put them in and wash them, but this one can be folded and unfolded when you put a big pot in, so it’s really great. Samsung is really smart. I’m totally in love with it! It shortens the time I spend washing dishes, and makes cooking at home more enjoyable. If you think it’s small because it’s for 6 people, you’re wrong! Since I brought in the Bisport dishwasher during the time I was doing the dishes, I have more time to talk to my kids. I used to think that dishwashers were wrong in this house and was frustrated, but OTL. (What should I do about the moisture in my eyes?) I am using it with great satisfaction. I chose the white color and the kitchen looks brighter. I am very satisfied. I received it in 2 days after ordering, so I was quickly freed from the need to wash dishes >.< And I connected it to the sink detergent container hole without drilling, so I didn't have to worry about the landlord's feelings at all, and it was easy to install because I didn't drill separately! And, it has a strong mode, a full wash mode, and a sterilization mode, so I’m so satisfied! I’m a professional cleaner + sensitive to grease, but I’m really satisfied with it. In particular, there’s a stand for placing plates or bowls, so you can put them in and wash them, but this one can be folded and unfolded when you put a big pot in, so it’s really great. Samsung is really smart. I’m totally in love with it! It shortens the time I spend washing dishes, and makes cooking at home more enjoyable. If you think it’s small because it’s for 6 people, you’re wrong! Since I brought in the Bisport dishwasher during the time I was doing the dishes, I have more time to talk to my kids. I used to think that dishwashers were wrong in this house and was frustrated, but OTL. (What should I do about the moisture in my eyes?) I am using it with great satisfaction. I chose the white color and the kitchen looks brighter. I am very satisfied. Sentence (English): Rocket Installation.
Comments (English): [ First time using rocket installation ] || ---------------- || Rocket Installation. I used Rocket Installation for the first time! First off, the best part was that it was so easy to select the installation date I wanted. I really liked that. I was able to get it installed starting two days after ordering. Advantages: I ordered the white one. As someone who likes things that stand out, I was really tempted by pink, but I figured white is a color you don't get tired of as easily when it comes to appliances. It was a good choice. I visited an electronics store to compare them. The SK Magic 6-place setting model didn't have a stainless steel interior. However, the Samsung one had the entire top part made of stainless steel, except for the bottom inner section. I thought that would be good for hygiene. Since a dishwasher is a device that washes dishes containing food, I couldn't help but consider hygiene. Also, I liked that the noise wasn't too loud even when running it at night. As for the capacity, it is sufficient for dishes for a family of three. The 12-place setting is nice, but we were satisfied with the 6-place setting. Review: Fortunately, I didn't have to drill a hole in the sink. I connected it to the faucet for water supply and just routed the drain directly into the sink. Water suddenly started leaking from the faucet after using it for a day following the installation. The technician who installed it came back to fix it, and their friendly service was also great.

Sentence (English): I purchased this new unit while moving.
Comments (English): [ Auntie's dishwasher that reduces dishwashing stress ] || ---------------- || I purchased this new unit while moving. I had only used commercial dishwashers before, but having experienced their convenience, I decided to buy one for my home as well. Users: 2 people (husband and wife) and 2 Bichon dogs. Installation: Two male technicians visited. The technician installed it without cutting the drain hose, explaining that it needs to be long enough. They kindly explained the simple operation methods. Installation is quick and takes about 15 minutes. How to use: Pre-wash with warm water to remove grease and food residue, then place the items on the rack, close the lid, and press the start button firmly. That's it. Noise during operation: There may be some noise, such as the sound of the machine washing, water, and drainage. I ran it on a quiet evening, and my husband asked what that sound was. Results: As a test, I just put in a bowl with tteokbokki sauce and chili powder on it. As you can see in the photo, all the red water was washed away. I love that I can disinfect the dogs' dishes and they come out squeaky clean, feeling like they were washed at high temperature. Even if you wash dish soap and scouring pads with hot water, disinfection is done separately. Sentence (English): We recently transitioned into our new residence and, to our dismay, inherited a highly unsatisfactory dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Don't spend your money on this. ] || ---------------- || We recently transitioned into our new residence and, to our dismay, inherited a highly unsatisfactory dishwasher. It appears to necessitate a thorough pre-wash of the dishes in the sink with soap before loading them into the dishwasher, rendering its purpose somewhat redundant. The dishes often come out with dried food remnants still adhered to them, or a murky film from residual milk. It's rather disappointing for a dishwasher to return more dirty dishes than clean ones, reflecting its subpar quality. This dishwasher leaves much to be desired, and I would strongly advise against purchasing it, given the multitude of superior quality brands and models available in the market. We have resolved to discard this appliance and replace it with a Bosch model.

Yesterday, the day before Thanksgiving, we started to get the same error code indicating that we had a leak. I took off the kick plate and the floor is bone dry and so is the drain pan.
